author: Unity
description:
Discover new Editor features available from Unity 6.3. These include grid rotation, new data columns that display more details in the Hierarchy window, advanced lighting search, a stats overlay that displays CPU and GPU rendering times as well as memory consumption, Splash screen customization, drag and drop overlays improvements, and a detailed physics debugger window, with gizmo visualization in the Scene view.

🔗 Link to documentation: https://on.unity.com/6_5_Docs

[00:00] Introduction
[00:09] Grid and snap settings
[02:25] Hierarchy columns
[03:18] Lighting search
[05:24] Stats overlay
[05:44] Splash screen
[06:07] Drag and drop overlays
[06:27] Physics debugger
